visualCharacteristics.purpose: Offer section: heading, text and CTAs beside an offer card showing a price stat and tick list
visualCharacteristics.layout: two columns on desktop; last column rendered as a card with large price stat and tick list

contentPattern.structure: One row with two cells: heading, paragraph, two CTA links | label, price paragraph (e.g. $0), note, bulleted list

reuseGuidance: Use for promotional offer call-outs. Write the price as a plain paragraph (not a heading) so it is detected as the stat.
